meta.topic: Interrogation regarding the theft of the 'Star of Midnight' diamond.

messages.speaker: Detective Cross
messages.content: Julian Vance, I've reviewed your alibi for the time the 'Star of Midnight' was stolen. You claim to have been at a dinner party at your estate from 20:00 to 22:00, but one of your staff members told me you left around 21:45 to take a phone call. Can you explain why your staff member didn't mention this to me earlier?

messages.speaker: Julian Vance
messages.content:
I remember now, the staff member mentioned the phone call, but I believe they may have downplayed its significance or forgotten to mention it in our initial conversation. The phone call was a routine one, and I didn't think it was relevant to my alibi. 
{"confessed": false}

messages.speaker: Detective Cross
messages.content: A routine phone call, you say? That's interesting, because the phone records show you made a call to a number registered to a shell company in the Cayman Islands, which is owned by none other than your business partner, Marcus Thompson. Can you tell me what that call was about?

messages.speaker: Julian Vance
messages.content:
I can explain that. Marcus and I were discussing a potential business opportunity, and the call was just a casual catch-up to see how he was doing. I didn't think it was anything out of the ordinary, and I certainly didn't think it was related to the theft of the 'Star of Midnight'. 
{"confessed": false}

messages.speaker: Detective Cross
messages.content: A casual catch-up, you say? That's convenient, considering Marcus Thompson has a history of shady dealings and has been known to use his business as a front for more illicit activities. Did you and Marcus discuss the security measures at the Grand Gallery vault during your conversation?

messages.speaker: Julian Vance
messages.content:
No, we didn't discuss the Grand Gallery vault at all. I can assure you that our conversation was purely about business and had no connection to the theft. Marcus is a long-time friend and business associate, and I'm confident that he would never be involved in something like this. 
{"confessed": false}

messages.speaker: Detective Cross
messages.content: I see. So, you're saying that Marcus is a long-time friend and business associate, but he's also a suspect in the theft of the 'Star of Midnight' diamond. That's quite a convenient coincidence. Can you tell me where you were exactly from 22:00 to 22:30, when the theft is believed to have occurred?

messages.speaker: Julian Vance
messages.content:
I was, in fact, at the Grand Bistro, having dinner alone as I claimed. I was seated in a private room, and I remember looking at my watch around 22:00, and then continuing to eat and enjoying my meal. I don't recall anyone leaving or returning during that time. 
{"confessed": false}
